item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone.

I go by RottenLB, and I decided to finally join the site after several years of finding an SCP reference on reddit, going "Oh, that site exists", reading a few of them and forgetting again.

Well, I read a lot more this time around, and decided that I would like to try my hand at writing one too. I'm not sure if I'll ever post something to the mainsite, but I'd like to go through the greenlighting/drafting process and see.

I would say I mostly identify with fire. I can go really enthusiastic about something fast, and lose that interest about as quick too, kind of like fire can be quickly lit and also extinguished.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Good Evening, all.

I'm DiamondFriday98, and I'm an aspiring fiction writer from the UK, as well as being a practising copy-writer. I am currently working on a remote placement year for a magazine company in China producing articles, proofreading and editing their English-language content. Aside from that I am studying in university on a Media Communications course.

I'm here on the SCP wiki both because the setting and entries have interested me for a long time, to destress from my usual job and recapture the joy of writing for it's own sake. I struggle with having few people close to me to show my work, or adequate motivation & formatting to keep my attention. I think the format of the SCP wiki, it's articles and whatnot will help me recapture my desire to write.

If (correct me if I'm wrong) we're supposed to answer the 'random question' in our posts, I'd say that I'm closest to Air, I tend to have a low attention span, moving from one subject/hobby to another constantly. I can strongly embrace them and then immediately evaporate, but I like to think I can always return to them.

I hope you'll all enjoy having me and we'll be able to constructively discuss each other's work and the world of the SCP wiki! And if necessary I may repost this in the upcoming month's thread as we only have about a day before December.

item.content:encoded:
You can just call me Chaos, it's a reference to a character I wrote a while ago that I intend to bring into the scp universe in the future. Im an avid (semi-experienced) story writer, I do best in short stories and flash fiction and Im good at writing the weird and bizarre so I feel this is where I belong.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hullo! My name is John.

I was introduced to skips maybe three years ago. Since then, I’ve always been coming up with different ideas for them, mostly lost to time. As you can maybe, possibly tell from my username, I especially like the Fifth Church. I also like ARGs, Xx_gaming_xX, and generally mucking about. I’m not much for writing- I’m more of an ideas person- so hopefully the collaborative element of the site will come in if I ever do post anything. I also edit ok.

I would like to say that I’m fire. I can’t. I’m more akin to earth. It’s always there. It supports heavy weights constantly, both the weight of man and the weight of nature, until it can no longer do so. Earth is really just a nice word for dirt. Rocks too, but dirt is at least what first comes to mind for me. It’s rarely the first choice. Fire is exciting and gives off sparks, air is above everything and has a kind of mystical quality to it, water can take exciting and creative forms. Earth is slow-moving. It nurtures and once it’s angry it stays that way, but there’s nothing much to it- at least not to the human eye. look, this ain’t really accurate, it said most representative

It’s a pleasure to introduce myself to y’all!

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello DrRobbieKB, welcome to the site! Don't stress too much on doing a good job, we are all here to have fun and help each other create great and interesting pieces of the site. The staff here is very fridnly and helpful so never worry about reaching out for help if you need it!
As for writing, just make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you! For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-4703 an SCP that is a totally legal and normal store with nothing out of the ordinary.

+ Resources
- Hide Resources

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerened, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

Best of luck!

Hey krystal-cipher, glad to have you officially with us! It usually goes like that for most people where they lurk a while before officially joining the site. It's always good to hear that you have your own SCP ideas already, but there is never a rush to come up with ideas. There are plenty of great tales to get lost in, and if you were looking for more I would suggest checking out the Canon Hub for some neat little universes people have created. Fire is a wonderful element, that can be interpreted in many ways. Most people see it as bad, but fire can also symbolize passion.

Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey hey!

I'm stormmageexpert (he/him/his). I'm a sophomore in college from Northern California, US, though I go to school in Connecticut. I'm headed to med school if I can swing it, and to linguistics fieldwork if I can't, though that all feels very far away and my day to day life at this point mostly consists of slaving over physics problems and playing Skyrim for too many hours in a row.

I'm mostly signing up so I can upvote, but I have a draft in a sandbox that I might work on more, or not, and I might get active in the fora, or not. I've been a big fan of this site for a while now, and I'm excited to be a member!

As for the QOTM, I'm probably earth, because I value being grounded in my own self and I can be really inflexible, even when it would probably be a good idea to be.
